name: Forest Run @ Sentosa 2027
short_description: Forest Run @ Sentosa 2027 runs its 21 km race on Sunday 25 April 2027 from Palawan Green on Sentosa, Singapore, after 7 km and 14 km races on Saturday 24 April, on mostly paved park connector loops.
ai_summary: Forest Run @ Sentosa 2027 is a two-day race weekend at Palawan Green on Sentosa Island, Singapore, organised by King Trail Events. The 7 km and 14 km run on Saturday 24 April 2027, and the 21 km on Sunday 25 April with a 7.30am flag-off. Each lap is a 7 km loop of mostly paved park connector with about 600 m of trail, and the organiser says it is not a trail race. Entry costs SGD 65-95 for single races, or up to SGD 175 for a dual 14 km plus 21 km entry.

faqs.question: When is Forest Run @ Sentosa 2027 taking place?
faqs.answer: The event runs over the weekend of 24 and 25 April 2027. The 7 km and 14 km races are on Saturday 24 April, starting at 7.30am and 8.35am, and the 21 km is on Sunday 25 April with a 7.30am flag-off. The organiser says start times may change closer to race day.

faqs.question: What distances and entry options are available?
faqs.answer: Single entries are 7 km, 14 km and 21 km. Runners can also take a 7 km plus 21 km or 14 km plus 21 km dual entry across both days. Early bird fees run to 31 December 2026, from SGD 65 for the 7 km to SGD 85 for the 21 km, then rise by SGD 10.

faqs.question: What is the course like on Sentosa?
faqs.answer: Every distance uses the same 7 km loop from Palawan Green: about 6.4 km of tarmac and concrete park connector plus 600 m of trail, so the 21 km is three laps. The organiser stresses it is not a trail race, which makes it a scenic, mostly paved half-marathon-length option on Sentosa.
